criteria.statement: Deployment create, approve, reject, and rollback use the existing registry policy and canonical-state publication paths; intent_id replay does not repeat side effects.
Runtime deploy, restart, and stop use the existing lifecycle service with org and permission checks.
LLM deploy, rollback, approve, and reject use the existing LLM registry transitions and fleet-operator gate.
Backup restore approval uses the existing restore-registry transition and triggers an approved restore once.
Known unauthorized principals receive rejection, stale supplied revisions receive conflict, and accepted intents receive bounded 30315 status.
Disabled intent domains retain the existing ContextVM or reactor action path; enabled domains use in-process dual dispatch.
Checked-in deployment-operation fixtures parse as kind-30900 intents and document client content shapes.
